item.title: Beyond the Bins: How does Panaji manage bulk waste without a landfill?
item.description: Panaji tackles waste management innovatively by enforcing strict rules on Bulk Waste Generators, ensuring waste is managed at the source through segregation and composting, despite lacking a landfill.

item.title: From bodybuilding to the local gym: How performance-enhancing drugs can damage the heart
item.description: Performance-enhancing drugs, once limited to elite sports, are now a public health concern as regular gym-goers increasingly use them. These substances pose severe risks to heart health, leading to conditions like cardiomyopathy and sudden cardiac death.
